name: pre_reorder_cutlass
description: Broadcast token rows into a paged expert input buffer. input is [num_tokens, hidden_size], gateup_input is [num_tokens*topk, hidden_size], and src2dst/topk_ids are [num_tokens, topk]. A slot is live when topk_ids[t,k] != num_local_experts; its destination row gateup_input[src2dst[t,k], :] is overwritten with input[t, :] scaled by 1/a1_scales when a1_scales is not None (otherwise unscaled), with scaling in float32 and a cast to gateup_input.dtype. Slots whose id equals num_local_experts leave their destination row untouched, and an empty topk_ids returns gateup_input unchanged. For contiguous inputs the kernel mutates gateup_input and returns it; a non-contiguous gateup_input is first made contiguous and that copy is written and returned. Suites exercise bfloat16 input/gateup_input, int32 ids/dst and an fp32 scalar scale.
